title: 約會
description: 約會與感情關係的表達

sentences.en: Would you like to go out for dinner?
sentences.zh: 你想一起出去吃晚餐嗎？

sentences.en: I had a really great time tonight.
Are you seeing anyone?
Can I take you out sometime?
sentences.zh: 我能找個時間約你出去嗎？

sentences.en: You look amazing tonight.
I really enjoy spending time with you.
sentences.zh: 我很享受跟你在一起的時光。

sentences.en: Would you like to see a movie this weekend?
I think we have great chemistry.
Let me walk you home.
I've been thinking about you a lot.
Do you want to be my partner?
I'm not ready for a relationship right now.
sentences.zh: 我現在還沒準備好談感情。

sentences.en: Let's take things slow.
I feel very comfortable around you.
sentences.zh: 跟你在一起我覺得很自在。

sentences.en: What are you looking for in a relationship?
I'd love to see you again.
Should we split the bill?
This is my treat tonight.
You make me really happy.
I think we should just be friends.
sentences.zh: 我覺得我們當朋友就好。

sentences.en: When can I see you again?
sentences.zh: 我什麼時候能再見到你？

sentences.en: I have feelings for you.
Do you believe in love at first sight?
We need to talk about us.
sentences.zh: 我們需要談談我們的關係。

sentences.en: I'm looking for something serious.
Let's go somewhere quieter.
sentences.zh: 我們去安靜一點的地方吧。

sentences.en: I appreciate your honesty.
You're really easy to talk to.
I had a wonderful evening with you.
sentences.zh: 跟你度過了美好的夜晚。

sentences.en: I'll text you when I get home.
